concepts.gloss: A general class including ordinary relative clauses and fused relatives with phrase status.
A construction in the relative family whose constituent is a clause, as distinct from a fused relative NP.

rules.concept: relative construction as a superordinate category
rules.statement: Relative construction is the broad term that includes both relative clauses and fused relative expressions that have phrase status, such as NPs; the more specific term relative clause is reserved for constructions that themselves are clauses.
rules.condition: For a construction involving a relative relation, classify the construction as a relative clause only if the relevant constituent has clause status; when a what-headed fused construction functions as the NP corresponding to a larger NP containing an ordinary relative clause, classify that whole constituent as an NP relative construction, not as a relative clause.
